priceSnapshot.note: TIMING DISCLOSURE FIRST, because it conditions every number below. This is the MORNING session and its nominal slot is 06:50 COT, but it executed at 00:05 COT on 21 September - roughly six hours and forty-five minutes EARLY - and it is the THIRD session to run inside fifteen minutes. The 2026-09-20 midday file published at 23:51 COT, eleven hours late; the 2026-09-20 endday file published at 00:05 COT, four and a half hours late and CONCURRENTLY with this one; and this morning file lands minutes behind it. The scheduler is firing a backlog in a burst rather than on its cadence. The practical consequence is that this file does not review a six-hour window; it reviews a window of roughly one minute against the endday handover and ten minutes against midday. Read the bias review with that in mind: almost nothing could have changed, and almost nothing did. Price is 81,405.6 against the endday mark of 81,398.9 and midday's 81,483.5 - up 6.7 points on the former, down 77.9 on the latter. The 24-hour range is unchanged at 80,173.5 to 82,099.0. What this session adds is not a new read of the market but an INDEPENDENT re-verification of it: every indicator, every EMA, every liquidation bucket below was recomputed from scratch from settled OKX candles read in-browser, with no value carried from either sibling file, and it reproduces the endday conclusion to the decimal - bullish, 53/31/16, the same three gates. Two small things moved across the ten minutes from midday: the first SHORT liquidations of this tape printed at 81,417.4 and 81,357.6, and the 1H momentum readings cooled a fraction as the 04:00 UTC bar settled.

decisionBox.changed: Nothing changes against the endday file, and that is the finding rather than an absence of one. Bias stays BULLISH, tilt bullish, probabilities 53/31/16 and confidence 6.20 - identical to the 2026-09-20 endday report published minutes earlier, which this session did not see until after its own numbers were computed. Two runs working the same tape from independently recomputed indicators landing on the same three figures is worth more than either run alone. Both gates and the invalidation are UNCHANGED at 80,750.0, 82,099.0 and 77,167.3: a desk that moves its levels on a one-minute window has no levels. Against the MIDDAY file ten minutes back the deltas are 54/30/16 to 53/31/16 and confidence 6.30 to 6.20 - the smallest downgrade this file can express, and a downgrade of EVIDENCE rather than of view. Position moves from the endday's HOLD to ADD, and that is the one real disagreement between the two files. The case for acting: price is 77.9 points BELOW where midday deployed, above all four EMAs on 15m and 1H with the stacks in clean bullish order, the 04:00 UTC hour settled at 81,404.1 as the eighteenth-plus consecutive close above the old 81,267.0 gate, and the reduce gate sits 655.6 points away. The one genuinely new datum supports it: the first SHORT liquidations of this window printed at 81,417.4, 81,391.9 and 81,357.6 inside the last five minutes, building an 86,337.24 USD short cluster in the 81,500 bucket just ABOVE spot. That is the first upward fuel this file has seen since the flush, and it is why the liquidity pull flips from down to up even though the long cluster below is six times larger - that one has already been burned. The size is what keeps the disagreement honest: a deliberately undersized tranche, not a full deployment. The 1H momentum readings cooling - RSI 58.19 to 57.32, histogram plus 47.80 to plus 44.42 - are why it is undersized. The resting stop stays NOT recommended: the 2026-09-21 midnight seeder is due in about two hours, so there is no overnight gap to cover.

calibration.note: This session declines to score its predecessors, and the refusal is the point. The comparison target should have been today's midnight file, which does not exist, then yesterday's endday, which also did not exist when this run began - so it was built against 2026-09-20-midday. While it ran, the 2026-09-20 ENDDAY session executed concurrently and published at 00:05 COT marking 81,398.9, and it backfilled the midday row's price_next_report to that figure. Two independent sessions therefore reviewed the same tape minutes apart and reached the same conclusion from separately recomputed indicators: bullish, 53/31/16, confidence 6.20, gates at 80,750.0 and 82,099.0, invalidation 77,167.3. They differ only on the wallet - endday held, this file adds a small tranche. On scoring: midday published BULLISH at 81,483.5 and the endday marked 81,398.9, which records a wrong tilt on an eleven-minute window; this file marks 81,405.6, six minutes later again. Booking ten- and one-minute windows as directional verdicts would corrupt a 214-row file built on six-hour intervals, so rollingRecord is held at 101 of 199 and no acting_helped verdict is issued. priorReduceFired is FALSE and that one IS a real measurement rather than a refusal: the 80,750.0 gate was never approached, the lowest trade since the midday handover being 81,381.0, which leaves 631.0 points of clearance. The 82,099.0 add gate was not approached either - the highest trade was 81,516.1, 582.9 points short. The 77,167.3 invalidation held with 4,238.3 points of clearance. One process note for the record, because the manifest will look odd: 19 September produced no reports at all and 20 September never ran its midnight or morning slots. Those nulls are UNRUN sessions, not failed writes.
